items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he used to always come in to clubs and we'd let him sit in

ctx.x: The guy that could play of those movie actors was Jackie Cooper. He was the one that could play, because he used to always come in to clubs and we'd let him sit in. But the rest of them, they had to have somebody play for them.
Who was it you drove your bargain with? Who was it that agreed to your terms?
